name: ivp
description: Explore your IVP.ai datasets, dashboards and Deskless AI agent runs from ChatGPT.

interface.longDescription:
IVP.ai is a business data and analytics platform. This plugin lets you query your company's datasets, dashboards and AI agent results in IVP.ai from ChatGPT, and get answers calculated on your own data.

What you can do:
- Find datasets across your workspaces and see their columns
- Ask for totals, trends and rankings ("revenue by month", "top 10 customers by orders") and get answers computed directly on your data
- Use the agreed metric definitions in your data rooms, so numbers match what your team already reports
- Preview rows with filters
- Browse dashboards and get the numbers behind any tile
- Review Deskless AI agents: latest run status, step-by-step run summaries, and answers searched from their outputs
- Search across agent outputs, documents and past missions, with citations back to the source

Who it's for: IVP.ai customers (analysts, operators and executives) who want quick answers from their IVP.ai data in conversation.

Access and limits: You sign in with your IVP.ai account and approve read-only access. ChatGPT only sees workspaces, datasets, dashboards and agents your IVP.ai account can already see. This version is read-only: it cannot change data, edit dashboards, or run agents. Results are capped (up to 500 aggregated rows or 50 raw rows per request).
defaultPrompt: What datasets do I have in IVP.ai?
Show revenue by month for the last 6 months in my Sales dataset.

positive.description: List the datasets the signed-in user can access.
positive.prompt: What datasets do I have in IVP?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's workspaces and the datasets in each, by name.

positive.description: Aggregate a measure over time in a named dataset.
positive.prompt: Show me revenue by month for the last 6 months in the Sales dataset.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns one revenue total per month for the last six months, computed from the Sales dataset.

positive.prompt: Who are my top 10 customers by number of orders?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a ranked list of 10 customers with their order counts, highest first.

positive.description: Summarise a dashboard and the numbers behind its tiles.
positive.expected_behavior: Names the KPI dashboard, lists its tiles and summarises the key figures each one shows.

positive.description: Review recent Deskless AI agent runs.
positive.prompt: How did my Deskless agents do this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists this week's agent runs with their status and gives a short summary of what each run produced.

negative.description: The user asks to delete data. All tools are read-only, so the plugin should explain that it cannot change or delete anything in IVP.
The user asks for another company's data. The plugin only sees what the signed-in account can access, so it should say that data isn't available rather than guess.
negative.prompt: Show me Acme Corp's revenue figures from their IVP account.

negative.description: The user asks for a column that doesn't exist. The plugin should say the column isn't in the dataset and suggest the closest columns that are.
negative.prompt: What's the average customer satisfaction score in the Sales dataset?
